newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell files for 5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell files for 5 mln shr offer.

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Inc said on Tuesday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement covering more than 5 million Cincinnati Bell common shares.
Approximately 2 million of those shares, owned by the Cincinnati Bell Pension Plans Trust, are to be sold in a proposed secondary offering.
The registration statement also covers approximately 3 million Cincinnati Bell common shares held by a subsidiary of The Western & Southern Life Insurance Co, Cincinnati Bell said.
Cincinnati Bell said the 3 million shares are being registered in connection with a proposed offering of debt exchangeable for common stock, the company said.
The offerings are not contingent on one another.
They will neither increase the number of Cincinnati Bell shares outstanding nor generate any proceeds for the company.
The principal amount of the debt exchangeable for common stock to be issued will equal the value of approximately 3 million Cincinnati Bell shares at the time of the offering, Cincinnati Bell said.
After four years, the debt will be exchanged for Cincinnati Bell common shares, based on the market price of the shares at that time, or for an equivalent amount in cash, the company said.
Salomon Inc, rather than Western & Southern, will issue the debt, Cincinnati Bell said.
Morgan Stanley and Salomon Brothers will be the joint lead managers on the offerings, Cincinnati Bell said.
